description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy of different attributes on a multi-retrieval task, comparing the performance of four models: Qwen2.5-7b-1M, Internlm3-8b, ProLong-8b, and Qwen2.5-7b, across five attributes: city, hobby, university, major, and birthdate. The horizontal axis lists the model names, while the vertical axis represents accuracy, ranging from 0 to 80 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 20. Each model is represented by a group of five bars, colored according to the attribute: city (teal), hobby (salmon), university (blue), major (purple), and birthdate (green). The bars within each group are not stacked, and their heights correspond to the accuracy for the respective attribute. The Qwen2.5-7b-1M model shows high accuracy across all attributes, with values near 90 for city, hobby, university, and birthdate, and slightly lower for major. In contrast, Qwen2.5-7b shows significantly lower accuracy, with most attributes near 0, except for birthdate, which is around 15. The other two models, Internlm3-8b and ProLong-8b, display varying accuracies across attributes, with Internlm3-8b ranging from around 55 for university to 87 for birthdate, and ProLong-8b having a notable drop in accuracy for major. The bars are grouped by model, and no specific sorting is applied within the groups. The chart is annotated with a legend explaining the color scheme for the attributes.
